purpose: Preserve supporting documents and role-specific narrative answers as versioned, evidence-grounded nodes of the applicant's application graph; capacity and slot effect are observed per employer form.

capacity_policy.zero_or_absent: Do not attach supporting documents and do not block when the employer has no file section.
capacity_policy.one_observed_supporting_slot: Prioritize reviewed cover letter; do not silently replace account-wide resume.
capacity_policy.two_observed_supporting_slots: Propose cover letter and job-specific resume only if both are accepted by the exact form and per-application isolation is verified.
capacity_policy.three_or_more_observed_supporting_slots: May add reviewed relevant case study after cover and job-specific resume, subject to actual accepted type and slot constraints.
capacity_policy.unknown_capacity: REVIEW_REQUIRED; Add button/screenshot alone is insufficient to prove number or accepted type.
capacity_policy.named_resume_slot: Delegate to canonical resume-selection-graph resolver; unknown/persistent platform slot never auto-overwritten.
capacity_policy.named_case_study_slot: Only propose a current, approved case study with verified accepted file type.
capacity_policy.accepted_mime_and_bytes: Match each live form's observed MIME/size limits and private PDF store constraints; no assumption based on file-picker icon.

narrative_answer_policy.same_claims_as_cover: All paragraphs derived from the same reviewed applicant evidence registry; tailored voice is a view, not new factual history.
narrative_answer_policy.review_requirement: Each answer and cover letter revision requires its own review/approval and source provenance; changing evidence stales descendants.
narrative_answer_policy.text_field_vs_attachment: Narrative answers fill semantically matched text fields only after exact approved preference; do not turn answer text into an attachment or vice versa automatically.
narrative_answer_policy.applicant_isolation: No cross-user, developer or collaborator answer/career context; no private text in public fixtures.

implementation.proof_ceiling: Synthetic graph, private-store and named-control tests do not establish actual Indeed Add-widget capacity, successful employer acceptance, or live runtime behavior.
